about: The pre-demo baseline set: five Realpage sites. Platform identified 2026-10-06 from public asset and API hosts on each home page; no site carries a generator tag, so each is inferred. Theme pins are each site's existing extracted theme, v1, all published (thevibe's was published for this baseline).

sites.themeNote: Was a draft; published 2026-10-06 for this baseline. Publish reported advisory contrast warnings: primary text on sunken surface 1.12:1, primary action label 2.9:1 (light); destructive action label 1.81:1 (dark).

sites.note: Supplied as https://promo.freehillstreetlofts.com/#/ — the fragment is dropped by every URL normaliser and the site uses no hash routing. Two pages: home and privacy policy. The main site (www.freehillstreetlofts.com, apts247/ResMan) is out of scope.
